infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nagpur Prime Property requires camera access to allow property sellers and agents to capture photos of their real estate property directly within the app for their listing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nagpur Prime Property requires photo library access to allow property sellers to select and upload photos and videos of their property when creating or updating a listing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Nagpur Prime Property requires access to save property brochures and images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Nagpur Prime Property uses your location to display nearby real estate listings on the map and automatically populate property addresses.
